name: vayu-v3-production
description: VAYU V3 production-ready PWA with AQI, weather intelligence, notifications, AYUSH guidance, exposure tracking, and backend sync.

scripts.build: echo Static PWA build ready. Deploy this folder to Netlify, Vercel, Firebase Hosting, or any HTTPS static host.
scripts.dev:full: echo "Run frontend and backend in two terminals: npm run serve and npm run backend:dev"
